title: Playboy June 2008 Jayde Nicole PMOY Steve Carell Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Front clean and bright; a crease at the upper-left corner of the back cover and light edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, June 2008. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Jayde Nicole, Playmate of the Year.

Cover features: Jayde Nicole is Playmate of the Year; Steve Carell gets smart in a Playboy Interview; The Black KKK by Jason Whitlock; Vegas showgirls; France's new first lady; the mastermind behind TMZ; Jane Smiley; the Playboy Bar - great vodkas; the death of the news?; incredible new folding gadgets.

Back cover: Wittnauer watch ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
